post.caption: Barbie once wore a real pink diamond. Mattel hired jeweler Stefano Canturi for a one of a kind Barbie. Canturi also designed her black strapless dress and pink heels. Her collar necklace holds three carats of white diamonds, and the design was inspired by Cubism. The center stone is a natural pink diamond of one carat from the Argyle mine in Western Australia. Christie's New York sold her on October 20, 2010, for 302,500 dollars, the most ever paid for a Barbie. All proceeds went to the Breast Cancer Research Foundation.
